## Description
Please include a summary of the changes, related issue link, and context for reviewers.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature causing existing functionality to change)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Refactoring / Code Quality / Performance improvement

## Testing & Verification
- [ ] Backend tests passing (`npm run test:backend`)
- [ ] Frontend tests passing (`npm run test:frontend`)
- [ ] Zero ESLint errors/warnings (`npm run lint`)
- [ ] Production build succeeds (`npm run build`)

## Checklist
- [ ] Code follows project style guidelines
- [ ] Performed self-review of changes
- [ ] Added inline technical documentation where applicable
